name: ZT603
tagline: Traditional cast iron craftsmanship with a widescreen fire view
description: The ZT603 is a premium wood-burning fireplace crafted from heavy-duty, thickened cast iron for exceptional heat retention and long-lasting durability. Featuring a timeless rectangular profile and a wide, panoramic ceramic glass viewing window, it acts as a stunning centerpiece while delivering powerful thermal comfort. Engineered with dual venting options, it offers great installation flexibility for modern and traditional homes alike.
features: Heavy-duty thickened cast iron body for long-lasting heat retention
Generous ceramic glass window offering a widescreen view of the flames
Versatile configuration with both top and rear flue outlets
Sturdy freestanding legs elevating the unit for safe heat distribution
Precision-engineered air controls and front-loading door handle
